ResourcePackManager.evidence: Exact Windows PE call chain: settings exit -> GeneralSettings stack apply -> queued event -> ResourcePackManager setStack/reload -> compose -> finalize. Apply scopes survive navigation and re-enter on the queued game event. Include-level flag is temporarily enabled only during in-world application, then restored. Static evidence is not visual runtime verification. v2 user observed persistence after leave/rejoin but no live apply; level_stack_included remained zero. v3 consumes only the exact supported apply functor in navigateToApplyResourcePacksScreen while a live local player exists, invokes on the current game thread with the current model, and releases game-owned callback exactly once. Title navigation and unrelated callbacks retain original behavior. No visual success inferred from counters.
